name: GhostTooltip
description: Headless tooltip root provider composing delay timing, open state, and GhostTooltipTrigger/GhostTooltipContent context.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is omitted.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Milliseconds before showing after hover or focus begins.

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description: Milliseconds before hiding after hover/focus ends (WCAG hoverable grace).

props.name: disableHoverableContent
props.description: When `true`, hides immediately on pointer/focus leave.

keyboard.Escape: Dismisses an open tooltip without moving focus.
